_notes: How to add a challenge: drop the binary in this directory, add an entry below, and (if user-facing) a row in README.md. Binaries NOT listed here are ignored by the test suite, so adding/removing binaries never breaks tests. If a binary is replaced by a different build, re-derive find_rva with: objdump -d <bin> | grep -n <success-string-xref>. find_symbol = symbol name (non-stripped only). find_rva = file address of the first success-only instruction (works for PIE and stripped: rebased at test time).
